module_summary: themeelems.cpp holds the theme element types split out of themes.cpp: per-device element filters (devices=), text elements (StaticText, AttributeText, GameCountText, ItemText) with collision-aware text rooms, image elements (StaticImage, GameImage, AttributeImage, Background, user wallpaper) and their cache/texture sharing (findDuplicate), the per-row cover redirect (thmGetElemForItem), and the internal elements (MenuIcon, MenuText, BdmIndex, ItemsList with center-out cover warming, SaveIcon, HintText, InfoHintText). All draw functions run on the GUI thread once per frame; the init functions run at theme load (GUI or IO worker). themes.h declares the theme data model (image_texture_t, mutable_image_t, mutable_text_t, items_list_t, theme_element_t, theme_elems_t, theme_t) and the theme API used by menusys, coverflow, grid and settings.

reusable_helpers.name: thmParseDeviceList
reusable_helpers.what: parses a comma-separated device-name list into a bitmask with strtok_r (thread-safe tokenising)

reusable_helpers.name: thmTextRoom
reusable_helpers.what: computes horizontal room for text on a row against a list of obstacle boxes and the screen edge

reusable_helpers.name: menuItemShown
reusable_helpers.what: decides whether a device menu page is navigable (visible, All Games filtering)

findings.title: findDuplicate shares the first COV cache whatever slot count the later element needs: synthesized Coverflow/Grid/PSBBN views can get a 2-slot cache
findings.problem: initMutableImage links any earlier element's cache with the same suffix (findDuplicate) and only creates its own cache when none was linked, so the FIRST COV element's slot count wins. A GameImage with pattern=COV gets count 1 floored to 2. For a disk theme without views=, thmViewSynthesize appends the template presenter after the theme's last main block, so a Coverflow (wants 20), PSBBN flow or Grid (wants 2 x cells, up to 48) built after such a GameImage shares its 2-slot cache. The eviction scan never takes an entry used this frame, so only 2 covers of the carousel/grid ever load; the rest stay on the default picture.
findings.fix: In findDuplicate, share a cache only when its count() is at least the slot count the new element asked for (pass cacheCount in from initMutableImage); otherwise let the element create its own cache as it already does when nothing matches.
findings.justification: Adds one parameter and one condition. The cache has no resize, so refusing an undersized share is the smallest change that gives presenters the slots their own code computes (grid.cpp:663-671, coverflow COVER_CACHE_SLOTS); the cost is at most a duplicate decode of the selected cover in the small GameImage cache.
findings.benefit: Fixes permanently missing covers (all but 2) in synthesized Coverflow/Grid/PSBBN views of disk themes that declare a GameImage pattern=COV before the presenter. Theme population affected is INFERRED.
findings.evidence: Read findDuplicate (themeelems.cpp:633-677) and initMutableImage (808-909): count from _count, floor 2 at 852-853, link before cacheInitCache at 884-891. themes.cpp:700-702 GameImage passes count 1; themes.cpp:1480-1491 synthesizes undeclared views for disk themes; themeviews.cpp:393,404-413 presenter types exclude GameImage, 495 copies it unchanged, 513-528 appends presenter after last block. coverflow.cpp:356 asks COVER_CACHE_SLOTS (20, themeint.h:76); grid.cpp:666-671 asks 2*cells. texcache.cpp:396-407 skips entries with lastUsed == guiFrameId. grep cacheResize/cacheGrow/count_ = : only texcache.cpp:59 (init), no resize. Built-in cfgs (misc/*.cfg) have no COV GameImage before a presenter, so only disk themes hit it (INFERRED).

findings.title: Unchecked malloc/calloc in theme element init (initMutableText, initImageTexture, initMutableImage, initBasic, initItemsList and others)
findings.problem: These allocations are written through immediately with no NULL check, so an allocation failure during a theme (re)load is a NULL write and a crash rather than a disabled element. The same file does check in initGameCountText (509-519), thmParseDeviceList (79-81) and thmWallpaperLoad (1766-1768), and coverflow.cpp:360 / grid.cpp:674 test initMutableImage's result for NULL, which it can never return because it dereferences the malloc result first.
findings.fix: Return NULL on allocation failure from initImageTexture, initImageInternalTexture (their callers already treat NULL as no texture) and initMutableImage (Coverflow/Grid already handle NULL; add the same early return in initStaticImage, initGameImage, initAttributeImage and initBackground). Leave initBasic/initItemsList as they are unless addGUIElem is changed too.
findings.justification: A theme reload happens mid-session (view switch, settings change) while art caches hold the heap; a NULL write there takes the menu down. Only a few early returns are added, and they make the existing NULL guards in coverflow.cpp and grid.cpp reachable.
findings.benefit: Crash becomes a disabled element under OOM at theme load; about 10 lines added. Failure of these small allocations is unlikely (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read every cited allocation: 211 malloc then field writes 212-217; 226 malloc then memcpy 227; 275 calloc then snprintf 277/279; 703 calloc then write 704; 723 malloc then memcpy 724; 767/774 same; 810 malloc then writes 811-826; 1608 malloc then writes 1610-1622; 2123 malloc then itemsListFit write at 2131. Callers: themes.cpp:687-801 (addGUIElem) deref elem after initBasic; coverflow.cpp:356-360 and grid.cpp:671-674 check the initMutableImage result.

findings.title: AttributeImage (built-in theme) and BdmIndex look up the internal texture id by name every frame
findings.problem: On the built-in theme, drawAttributeImage calls thmAttributeTexId every frame (snprintf for 'value/asset' values, then texLookupInternalTexId, a linear strcmp over the ~129 internal texture names) although the value only changes when currentConfigId changes. The built-in info page has 7 AttributeImage elements, so the GUI thread repeats up to 7 snprintf plus about 900 strcmp per frame for an unchanged result; drawBDMIndex does one snprintf plus the same scan per frame on the main page.
findings.fix: In drawAttributeImage resolve the texId once inside the existing currentConfigId != config->uid() block and keep it in the element (currentCacheId is unused on the built-in branch), then draw from the stored id. Leave drawBDMIndex as it is unless the same edit is made there for free.
findings.justification: No new state is needed for AttributeImage: the uid-gated refresh block already exists and currentCacheId is idle on that branch, so the per-frame work is removed by moving one call.
findings.benefit: About 7 x 129 strcmp + up to 7 snprintf per frame removed on the built-in info page, roughly 50 us per frame at 294 MHz (INFERRED: ~15 cycles per mismatching strcmp).
findings.evidence: Read drawAttributeImage 1517-1577: config uid gate 1525-1533, per-frame thmGetTexture(thmAttributeTexId()) at 1536 on the built-in path; thmAttributeTexId 1506-1515; textures.cpp:349-362 linear strcmp over TEXTURES_COUNT; include/textures.h enum has ~129 entries (counted with awk). misc/conf_theme_OPL.cfg:238-286 has 7 AttributeImage attributes (#Media, #Format, Vmode, Aspect, Scan, Players, Rating). drawBDMIndex 1917-1925 snprintf + lookup per frame. Timing is an estimate, not measured.
